integrity: Original mathematical derivation and direct diagnostic computation are included. Diagnostic finite grids do not establish infinite-dimensional optimality. Related literature is identified with a residual risk of more general implicit prior coverage.
scientific_limitations: The operator-norm minimax theorem is for nonnegative self-adjoint generators and two nested trapezoid-corrected sampled resolvents; no nonnormal, finite-time truncation, stochastic-noise, or high-order convergence assertion is made. The sharpness model attains the universal bound only when h lambda <= 4 z_*.
title: Sharp minimax two-grid resolvent blending for positive self-adjoint semigroups
